snippet.title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park Showcase
snippet.description:
Pre-order The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park, coming November 3, to get a Central Park-inspired mask at launch: https://store.ubisoft.com/6a67fbf5262bc75df33a9622.html
 
Watch the Echoes of Central Park DLC Showcase, featuring new gameplay reveals, exclusive developer interviews, special offers, and announcements about what’s coming for The Division 2. 

Get a closer look at the darkest and most disturbing DLC yet, as Agents venture into Central Park for the first time in franchise history to uncover the truth behind a mysterious new threat.

And register for the chance to participate in upcoming tests for The Division 2: Survivors extraction shooter expansion: thedivision2.com/register

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.

#Ubisoft #TheDivision2

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
